title: Add Tunemory to learn
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Tunemory](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-tunemory) to learn
- Turn a fact, formula or word list into a short catchy song that helps you remember it. Paste your notes, pick a style, and get lyrics that keep every fact and number (checked in code before they are s

Fixes #15743, fixes #15727

gist.headline: Notes with a chorus
gist.blurb: Tunemory joins Learn with a reasonable proposal: if the formula has to stick, give it a tune. Paste notes, pick a style, and get a short song that keeps the facts and numbers intact.
gist.summary: Added Tunemory to the Learn app listings; it turns pasted facts, formulas, or word lists into short songs and checks that the lyrics preserve every fact and number.
gist.impact: Learners get a way to turn their notes into catchy lyrics without dropping the details they need to remember.
gist.visual_concept: Tunemory is a study-to-song app; no logo or mascot is identified. Show Polli wearing tiny headphones beside a notebook of formulas and numbers, with musical notes carrying those details toward a small retro speaker. Code-plants and flowers make the study space feel like a cozy garden.
